main_body: A fish tank: a wooden-framed glass box showing water, fish and a sand bed, drawn flat from the front
top_band: none. At the top there is a 1-2 row orange-brown frame rim (rows ~9-12) with a light band of glass highlight below it (rows 13-14). These read as a frame edge and glass glare, not a horizontal surface seen from above.
evidence: Reading a column through the middle: dark outline at row 8, then a brown frame rim rows 9-10 and a blue water/glass interior with the fish drawn in side view. The glass interior is a vertical face seen straight on, with the water level, plants, fish and sand all shown as a flat cross-section. The top rim is 1-2px thick and no lid or water surface is visible from above, so this is a rim-only front elevation. The kind is also questionable, since it is a tank rather than tall furniture against a wall.

style.evidence: The frame is outlined in a dark orange-brown that follows the wood, which is good. The water has only 2-3 blue tones with large flat fills (the lower water area is about 40x10 px of near-uniform blue), and the sand has some dotted grain. Plants and fish carry a few greens. Compared with the references, which have 5-6 steps and dense texture on the roof, stonework and wood, the candidate is flatter and its tiles carry fewer colours, so it reads thinner.
